description: Search FTC (Federal Trade Commission) enforcement cases and proceedings by company name, individual name, case/matter number, or keyword, with optional date range, merger-vs-non-merger filter, and case-status filter. Covers both competition (antitrust/merger) and consumer-protection enforcement — complaints, consent orders, settlements, and federal-court actions. Returns each matching case's title, FTC slug (pass to ftc_case_detail for documents), type of action, case status, and last-updated date. Example: ftc_search_cases({ query: "Kroger", category: "merger" }).

category.description: Restrict to merger enforcement, non-merger (conduct) enforcement, or both ("any", the default).

end_date.description: Latest "last updated" date to include, YYYY-MM-DD.

limit.description: Max cases to return, newest-updated first. Default 20, max 100.

query.description: Company name, individual name, case/matter number, or keyword. Omit to browse all cases (combine with category/status/dates).

start_date.description: Earliest "last updated" date to include, YYYY-MM-DD.

status.description: Restrict to cases in this status. Omit for any status.

name: ftc_search_cases
title: Ftc Search Cases
